title: Chicken, bean and cavolo nero soup

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or an accepted staple such as tinned tomatoes, tinned beans, stock and Parmesan.

supermarket.reason: Every item, cavolo nero and Parmesan included, is an everyday line at Tesco and similar shops.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one large pan, two forks and a grater, and poaching then shredding chicken is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two breasts poached for 20 minutes in 1.2 litres of stock with two tins of beans and 200g of greens gives a well-balanced, properly cooked soup for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers the chopping, stripping the cavolo nero, shredding the chicken and grating, and the steps add up to about 40 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, nothing unlisted is used, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming bean and greens soup suits mid-February, and the cavolo nero is a main component named in the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, beans, vegetables and greens make a filling, balanced family dinner.
